author: Forster, 1795
status: 나그네새, 해마다 수십 마리 · 여름에도 드물게 기록(10건 미만)
summary: 봄과 가을에 매우 적은 수가 국내를 지나가는 나그네새로, 해안가 풀밭과 하천, 농경지에서 보인다. 작은 무리를 지어 다니며 날면서 파리나 벌 무리의 곤충을 잡아먹는데, 가볍고 빠르게 나는 모습이 제비를 닮았다. 둥지를 짓지 않고 맨땅에 알 2~3개를 낳는다. 시베리아 동북부, 몽골 북동부, 중국 동북부, 인도차이나반도, 인도, 필리핀, 대만에서 번식하고 동남아시아에서 호주에 걸쳐 겨울을 난다.

art.subject: Oriental Pratincole (Glareola maldivarum), adult in breeding plumage, as seen in Korea on spring passage: crown, upperparts and wing coverts plain olive grey-brown; flight feathers blackish; lores black; throat pale creamy buff, sharply outlined by a thin black line that runs from the eye down and around the lower throat; upper breast olive-brown merging into a warm orange-buff lower breast and upper belly; lower belly and undertail white. Bill short and arched, black with a bright red base; large dark eye; legs short and blackish.
art.pose: hawking insects in swift, buoyant flight low over a field
art.scene: Korean coastal grassland beside farmland during spring migration; no people, buildings or text
views: adult breeding, side view standing: horizontal stance, short arched black bill with red base, creamy throat outlined by a thin black necklace, olive-brown upperparts and upper breast, orange-buff belly, white lower belly, blackish wingtips projecting well past the tail, short dark legs

adult in flight, seen from below: long pointed wings with chestnut underwing coverts and dark flight feathers, creamy throat with black border, white vent, shallowly forked black tail with a white base
adult in flight, seen from above: plain olive-brown back and wing coverts, blackish flight feathers without a white trailing edge, white rump, shallowly forked black tail
art.build: Tern-like wader, 26.5cm, a little smaller than a feral pigeon and much slimmer, with a large head, very short neck and horizontal stance; runs like a plover on the ground. Bill much shorter than the head, arched, with a wide gape like a swallow's. Legs short. Very long, narrow, pointed wings: at rest the wingtips extend well beyond the tail. Tail short, black with a white base, shallowly forked. Flies like a large swallow: dark upperwing without a white trailing edge, chestnut underwing coverts, white rump and uppertail coverts.
avoid: Do not paint long legs or a long bill; pratincoles have short legs and a short, arched, swallow-like bill.
Do not give it a long, deeply forked tail with streamers; the tail is short and the folded wings extend well beyond it.
Do not paint a white trailing edge on the secondaries (Collared Pratincole).
Do not paint red on the bill tip; only the base is red.
Do not paint a pure white throat; it is creamy buff.
